## 简体中文

- 包含 beta.14 的资源中继出口策略、远程规则资源统一导出、代理设置界面优化和国内网段系统路由。
- 修复 Linux 国内路由批处理及跨平台 DNS 刷新接口的静态检查，恢复完整发布流程。
- 服务器保持无代理核心架构，托管出口由独立代理服务提供。

## English

- Include beta.14 resource relay egress policies, centralized remote rule resource exports, proxy settings improvements, and system routes for Chinese IP prefixes.
- Fix Linux route batch formatting and platform-specific DNS flush lint checks to restore the release workflow.
- Keep the server core-free, with managed egress provided by the separate proxy service.
